Summary: aTDS: data-driven TDS window, lag range and tolerance with careful synthetic validation, one EEG pair and network tests; v2 adds minor clarifications on time resolution, out-of-range diagnostics and scope of per-link power.
Strengths: Principled, fully specified rules addressing a real reproducibility problem.
Weaknesses: No staged or multi-subject real data.
Constants other than 30 not varied; null biases qualitative.
Joint B_xy supported by one configuration.
Questions: Per-stage calibration on a real cohort?
Per-link power in the slow-down setting?
